theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_dilation
theorems.statement: ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ dil : ∀ k : ℕ, ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, ∀ (k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam (X - Y) = dil k lam X - dil k lam Y) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam⁻¹ (dil k lam X) = X) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (dil k lam X).mass = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ k) * X.mass) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (dil k lam X)) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), (dil (k + 1) lam X).boundary = dil k lam X.boundary) ∧ (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (E : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) ((fun x => lam • x) '' E) → dil k lam X ω = 0) ∧ (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = lam ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (lam • x)) ∧ dil k lam X ω = X η) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), ∫ y in (fun x => lam • x) '' A, g y ∂μHE[k] = lam ^ k * ∫ x in A, g (lam • x) ∂μHE[k]
